fixed_format_identifier_entry_surface_la: Example State official voter-information fixed-format identifier-entry fail-open policy
delivery_role_note: Critical official voter-information routes that depend on a fixed-format or mixed-format public identifier keep exact-character expectations, leading-zero handling, keyboard posture, and retry guidance clear enough that the current official answer does not depend on guessing whether the token is a number or an exact string.
identifier_kind_scope_note: Each critical route says which public identifier it expects and whether a bounded alternate token or help path exists when that identifier is unavailable.
exact_string_not_number_note: Routes that depend on exact public tokens preserve exact-string semantics rather than treating every digit-only value as an incrementable number field.
visible_format_and_length_note: The route exposes useful format and length cues before failure, including whether letters, spaces, or hyphens are allowed, optional, or required.
leading_zero_separator_case_note: Leading zeros and meaningful letters or separators survive typing, paste, review, and retry without hidden coercion that changes the lookup outcome.
keyboard_hint_and_field_type_note: Mobile keyboard hints support the expected token posture without forcing number-control semantics that are unsafe for exact identifiers.
mask_paste_and_correction_note: Any mask or segmented helper remains subordinate to the answer lane by allowing paste, mid-string correction, and accessible review.
identifier_error_recovery_note: A failed lookup preserves the entered value, explains whether the problem is format, identifier kind, or no matching record, and keeps first-party help visible.
no_hidden_normalization_or_context_chang: Typing or editing an identifier does not silently submit, reroute, or hide how characters were normalized for matching.
same_answer_across_identifier_variants_n: Typed, pasted, spaced, and separator-free variants that refer to the same public token resolve to the same authoritative answer or the same explainable recovery posture.
